body: We need to make `Replica` keep track of (logical) time so that it can detect timeouts based on the `tick()` event. This simplifies simulation as well because we can, for example, just stop generating messages from primary and the backups will detect it's down on their own and initiate a view change.

comments.body: Done, though on_idle kept its name: it is the tick. The replica counts idle periods itself and detects a silent primary on its own, with Config::primary_timeout idle periods before it starts a view change (06ba5de) and exponential backoff between view changes that do not complete (8ab4fff). The simulator does exactly what this issue describes: it stops delivering to a crashed primary and the backups notice and change view without any help. Since f9a6d4e the owner steps the replica with on_message and on_idle and drains what it produced, so there is no other clock.

title: Remove `on_idle()` from Replica
